high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "marketingmind.in." The post features two smartphones side by side, each displaying a different individual. On the left is a Samsung smartphone with a person dressed in a suit and tie, and on the right is an iPhone with another person wearing glasses and a sweater. The text overlay on the image reads: "When Samsung sold its Galaxy S II at $2 Right Next to iPhone 4S lineup." This suggests a comparison between the pricing strategies of Samsung and Apple during a specific period.
